stories.title: TD-057 stale git index.lock guarded helper (slow-NAS)

grounding: Heuristic = TD-057 line 22 (PM-validated hand-clear): 0-byte + mtime-age + no-live-git-process
Handbook §13 Rule-4 discipline invariant: never force a lock while a git process is running

stories.completionNotes: AUDIT (acceptance#1): failure mode per TD-057 = orphaned git leaves a 0-byte .git/index.lock on the slow SMB share, blocking all write git ops (add/commit/stash) while reads work; recurred US-367 + Sprint 49 (~2h HUMAN_INTERVENTION). Live-git detection: exact process-name match (git/git.exe) NOT substring (TD-057 warns 'Logitech' false-matches) -- tasklist /FI IMAGENAME filter on Windows, ps -e -o comm= on POSIX. DESIGN: index_lock.py encodes the PM's validated 3-condition heuristic; conditions checked in FIXED order with the live-git gate FIRST so no later branch can ever authorize a delete under a live process (the load-bearing invariant). Default detector fails SAFE = assume-live on any probe error (uncertainty never authorizes a destructive op; the retry-defaults-to-uncertain rule). clearStaleIndexLockWithBackoff retries on [1,2,4,8,16] to wait out a genuinely-live commit (lock vanishes on its own) -- non-empty lock is terminal (won't cure by waiting -> escalate). CLI: python -m offices.pm.scripts.index_lock --repo . [--check]; exit 0 safe-to-proceed / 2 refused. WIRING (acceptance#3): usage fully documented in module docstring + --help; wiring into /closeout-pm + /sprint-deploy-pm + Ralph's lock-blocked path + handbook §13 is PM-owned (shared docs/skills, lane discipline) -> handed off via inbox note (US-462/464 precedent). VALIDATION: VC1 stale-lock (no git) -> real-git end-to-end test: plant lock -> commit BLOCKED -> guard CLEARS -> commit SUCCEEDS. VC2 live-held -> refuses + NEVER deletes across the full backoff schedule. 17 targeted tests pass, ruff clean on both .py. PM/integration gate: full pytest + mypy strict (not in-loop).
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: confirm the failure mode (stale index.lock from the slow SMB share blocking commits) + how to reliably detect a live git process holding the lock
helper retries-with-backoff on lock; clears ONLY if no git process is running AND the lock exceeds an age threshold; NEVER force-deletes under a live process (the discipline invariant)
documented usage; wired where PM commits happen if practical
ruff clean in-loop
